## Company Overview

**Name:** CodeTeak (Codeteak Technologies Pvt. Ltd.)
**Founded:** 2025
**Website:** https://codeteak.com
**Email:** info@codeteak.com
**Phone:** +91 99952 03149

CodeTeak builds simple, reliable software for businesses. It makes two products — **Yaadro** (home delivery and online ordering for shops) and **Lens** (simple camera attendance for any business) — and offers **Product Engineering**, **Product Design**, and **Cyber Security** services for companies that need custom web and mobile apps.

The team of experienced developers, designers, and consultants collaborates closely with clients to deliver clean, maintainable code and seamless user experiences. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, with a strategic presence in Dubai, UAE, CodeTeak serves diverse industries including retail, e-commerce, logistics, supermarkets, restaurants, and growth-stage startups.

### Key Metrics
- 100+ Projects Delivered
- 50+ Active Clients
- 95% Client Satisfaction
- 25+ Partners

### Why Choose CodeTeak
- Modern tech stack
- Agile methodology
- 24/7 support
- Scalable architecture
- Code quality assurance
- Fast delivery

### Engagement Models
- Project-based fixed-price engagements
- Monthly retainers for ongoing support
- SaaS subscriptions for in-house products

## Services

URL: https://codeteak.com/services

CodeTeak offers comprehensive software development services across three main categories:

### Cyber Security
Protecting digital assets with advanced security solutions and AI-powered threat detection.

1. **Threat Detection & Prevention** — AI-powered systems that identify and neutralize cyber threats in real-time, protecting infrastructure from attacks before they cause damage.
2. **Fraud Prevention & Detection** — Advanced fraud detection systems that analyze patterns and behaviors to prevent financial fraud, identity theft, and unauthorized access.
3. **Security Audit & Compliance** — Comprehensive security assessments and compliance checks to ensure systems meet industry standards and regulatory requirements.
4. **Network Security** — Robust network security solutions including firewall management, intrusion detection, and secure network architecture design.
5. **Data Protection & Encryption** — End-to-end encryption and data protection services to safeguard sensitive information and ensure secure data storage and transmission.
6. **Incident Response & Recovery** — Rapid response services to mitigate security breaches, investigate incidents, and restore systems to secure operational states.

### Product Engineering
Building scalable and innovative products from concept to market.

1. **Backend Development** — Robust server-side architecture and APIs that power applications with scalability and reliability.
2. **Frontend Development** — Creating intuitive, responsive user interfaces that deliver exceptional user experiences across all devices.
3. **Cloud Infrastructure** — Designing and deploying scalable cloud solutions that adapt to growing business needs.
4. **DevOps & CI/CD** — Automating workflows and deployment pipelines for faster, more reliable software delivery.
5. **Microservices Architecture** — Building modular, independent services that work together to create flexible and maintainable systems.
6. **API Development** — Creating secure, well-documented APIs that enable seamless integration and communication between systems.

### Product Design
Crafting beautiful, intuitive experiences that users love.

1. **UI Design** — Creating visually stunning and cohesive interfaces that align with brand and engage users.
2. **UX Design** — Designing user-centered experiences that are intuitive, accessible, and solve real user problems.
3. **Prototyping** — Building interactive prototypes to test concepts and validate ideas before development begins.
4. **Design Systems** — Establishing comprehensive design systems that ensure consistency and accelerate development across teams.
5. **User Research** — Understanding user needs and behaviors through research to inform data-driven design decisions.
6. **Accessibility Design** — Ensuring products are usable by everyone, including users with disabilities, following WCAG guidelines.

### Legacy / Additional Services
- **Web Development** — Modern, responsive, scalable web applications using latest technologies and frameworks.
- **Mobile App Development** — Native and cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android.
- **Software Development** — Custom software solutions tailored to business needs, from concept to deployment.
- **AI Integration Systems** — Integrating artificial intelligence and machine learning into existing systems and workflows.
- **Security & Protection Systems** — Enterprise-grade security solutions to protect data, applications, and infrastructure.

## Products

URL: https://codeteak.com/products

CodeTeak makes two products: **Yaadro** (home delivery and online ordering for shops) and **Lens** (simple camera attendance for any business). Online ordering is part of Yaadro, not a separate product.

### Yaadro — Home Delivery and Online Ordering for Shops
URL: https://codeteak.com/products/yaadro

**Headline:** Deliver faster. Stay connected.

**In one line:** Manage home delivery for your shop. Track orders, assign delivery partners, and keep customers updated. Also includes online ordering with pay on delivery.

Yaadro helps shops manage home delivery from start to finish. It connects the shop, the delivery partner, and the customer in one simple place, with apps for shops and delivery partners and a clear dashboard for managers.

**Who it is for:** Shops, supermarkets, and their delivery partners.

**Main features:**
- See where every order is
- Apps for shops and delivery partners
- Simple dashboard for managers
- Online orders with pay on delivery
- Clear updates for everyone
- Works with Task billing

**What you get:**
- **Shop App** — Manage orders and deliveries from your phone anytime.
- **Delivery Partner App** — Get orders, follow the route, and update delivery status.
- **Web Dashboard** — See all orders and operations in one simple screen.
- **Live Tracking** — Follow deliveries as they happen and get instant updates.
- **Easy Messaging** — Chat between the shop, delivery partner, and customer.
- **Order Control** — Create, assign, and finish deliveries without confusion.

**Works with Task billing:** Shops create home delivery orders in Task. Those orders go straight into Yaadro, where you can assign a delivery partner and track the order until it arrives.

**How it works (three simple steps):**
1. **Create the order** — Make a home delivery order in your shop system. It appears in Yaadro automatically.
2. **Assign a delivery partner** — Yaadro helps send the order to the right available delivery partner.
3. **Deliver and finish** — Track the trip live and mark the order done when it reaches the customer.

**Benefits:** Faster home deliveries · Less confusion between teams · Customers stay updated · Easy day to day control

#### Online ordering (part of Yaadro)
URL: https://codeteak.com/products/yaadro#ecommerce

**Order online. Pay on delivery.** Each shop gets its own online store. Customers open the shop link, pick products, and order from phone or computer. They pay when the order arrives. Shop staff manage the orders, and CodeTeak runs and supports the platform.

**Yaadro FAQ:**
- **Can customers pay online?** No. They pay when the order arrives. Online pay can be added later.
- **Can each shop have its own products?** Yes. Every shop has its own products and prices.
- **How do customers order?** They open your shop link, pick products, and order from phone or computer.
- **Who supports the system?** CodeTeak runs it, updates it, and helps when you need.

---

### Lens — Simple Camera Attendance for Any Business
URL: https://codeteak.com/products/lens

**Headline:** Simple attendance for your team

**In one line:** Easy attendance for any business. Staff check in by looking at the camera. No cards or fingerprints.

Lens helps any business track attendance just by looking at the camera. It is fast, accurate, and keeps working even when there is no internet.

**Who it is for:** Any business with staff, such as shops, supermarkets, offices, restaurants, clinics, salons, warehouses, and factories. It works for one location or many.

**The problem it fixes:** Paper lists and fingerprint machines slow people down. With Lens, staff walk in, the camera knows them, and attendance is marked. No cards to lose and no long queues.

**Top features:**
1. **Clock in with a glance** — Staff look at a tablet at the door. No cards, no PINs, no paper registers.
2. **See who is at work, live** — Know who is in, late, or absent as it happens, not at the end of the day.
3. **Pay and advances in one place** — Track salaries, bonuses, and salary advances with a clear history of every change.
4. **Reports in one click** — Download attendance and payment sheets for HR, finance, or audits whenever you need them.

**Also included:**
- **Quick face check-in** — Staff are recognized as they enter. Attendance is marked in seconds, even on busy days.
- **Works without internet** — If the internet goes down, Lens still records attendance. When it comes back, records sync automatically.
- **One or many locations** — Manage one place or many from the same system. Each location stays private and separate.
- Only authorized people can view staff data.

**Benefits:** No cards, PINs, or fingerprint machines · Keeps recording attendance offline · Helps managers see who is present quickly · Each location's data stays private · Ready for real workplace use from day one

**Lens FAQ:**
- **What is Lens?** Lens is an attendance system for any business. Staff check in by looking at the camera. No cards, PINs, or fingerprint machines.
- **How does Lens work?** When someone arrives, the camera recognizes them and marks attendance. Managers can see who is present anytime.
- **Is Lens safe?** Yes. Only the right people can see staff and attendance data. Each location stays private.
- **Can it work without internet?** Yes. Lens keeps marking attendance offline. When the internet returns, everything syncs.
- **How accurate is it?** Lens is very accurate at recognizing the right person, and it gets better with everyday use.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What services does CodeTeak offer?**
CodeTeak offers comprehensive software development services including custom development, performance optimization, security & compliance, and team augmentation. Services span cyber security, product engineering, product design, web/mobile development, AI integration, and cloud/DevOps.

**How long does a typical project take?**
Project timelines vary based on complexity and scope. Simple applications can be completed in weeks, while enterprise solutions may take several months. CodeTeak works closely with clients to establish realistic timelines.

**What technologies do you work with?**
Modern tech stacks including React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, TypeScript, React Native, Flutter, and cloud platforms like AWS and Azure.

**Do you provide ongoing support?**
Yes — 24/7 support and maintenance services including updates and enhancements to ensure applications continue to perform optimally after launch.

**Can you work with our existing team?**
Yes — team augmentation services allow seamless integration with existing development teams to provide additional expertise and accelerate projects.

**How do you ensure code quality?**
Industry best practices including code reviews, automated testing, continuous integration, and quality assurance processes for clean, maintainable, well-documented code.
